    - Why: in run 38051 luna's RESULT named D2 vs C2 as deciding, and an applied send-back then turned luna's own D2 vs C2 line to UNDERDETERMINED. The K-RUD check at Panel Payloads runs before the apply, so it never saw the pair held open.
    - What it does: on the corrected text after the apply, a RESULT graded DEFENDER WINS or CHALLENGER WINS that names a pair "D<n> vs C<m>" whose own collision line in the same text is graded UNDERDETERMINED raises one RULE K-RUD gate item for that pair (src E-GATE RUD, live false), after the pkgVNV items, so earlier gate ids keep their numbers. The RESULT is split into clauses at ". ; : --" and at commas. A clause holding a K-RUD open word is passed over. So is a pair named to set it aside: not, no, neither, nor, aside, apart from, without, except or other than in the three words before it, or not, no, neither, nor, aside or "does/is not" just after it. Not read: an engine-derived RESULT ("derived after", "derived by", "recomputed after").
    - The item asks the judge to settle one of the two: regrade the pair on the verse's own words, or write the RESULT again without resting on the pair (Commitment 13).
    - The item rides a gate call the seat already has. A seat whose only gate items are K-RUD gets no gate call; Gate Record writes one E-GATE row per item, UNCURED, with the reason "GATE NOT SENT | ... (RECORD-ONLY)".
    - The answer is recorded and never applied. A CHANGE given for the K-RUD item is not added to the applied changes; it is put in place of its line on a copy of the corrected text, and the pair test is read again on the copy. The record reads "WOULD CURE: with the CHANGE in place on a copy, the RESULT no longer rests on an UNDERDETERMINED pair" or "STILL RAISED: ...", each ending "(TRIAL K-RUD: recorded, not applied, not counted)". A RESULT change replaces the RESULT line on the copy; a pair change replaces every line of that label. A KEEP does not settle it. A CHANGE given for a live item on the same line is still applied through that item.
    - No count moves: K-RUD gate items are live false, so they enter no uncured tally, no pkgVP1 or late-gate filter, and no send-back count-off (which takes only E-APPLY S<n> lines whose change was applied).
    - Shown offline: over the final text of the 45 stored judgments of run 38051, one hit, luna D2 vs C2; the same text before the apply gives none. Not shown by a run.
    - Limits: only a seat whose text reaches the gate (a seat with a send-back apply) is read; the phrase test (K-RUD at Panel Payloads) still covers the rest. A RESULT that rests on the pair's verse without naming the pair is not caught. A pair set aside with "is not broken" or "has no break" is passed over. A K-RUD-only seat leaves no AUDIT line in its judgment text; its log row is its record. A WOULD CURE item carries cure_status CURED and "CURED:" in its AUDIT v38 line, so read these rows by their reason. A judge whose K-RUD CHANGE rides a call is not told it was recorded and not applied.

- The press reader (g4Press2024, ASK 357): a line that says the answer does not meet the PRESS leaves the pressed witness unanswered (ruling 372), so it takes the unanswered-witness path and an honest retraction of it cures. It reads the whole line outside quotations, not only from GROUND on. P1: "answer misses / does not meet / did not meet / fails to meet / does not answer the <up to 3 words> press" or "pressed". P2: "press" or "pressed", up to 2 words, then "is not met" or "was not met". Not read: a meaning word (meaning, sense or reading, singular or plural) in the P1 words before "press", or directly or one word after "press" or "pressed"; for P2, a meaning word anywhere earlier in the clause; a clause holding not, never, no or nor before the match. So "the answer misses the meaning pressed", "the pressed meaning is not met" and "the meaning that was pressed is not met" stay meaning breaks.

Naming Commitment 5 is not the test, because meaning breaks name it too.
